faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.orderHow: How do I place an order?
faq.orderHowAnswer: Choose a product, add it to your cart, and complete checkout from the Cart page.
faq.cancelOrderAnswer: You can cancel an order while it is still in Pending confirmation status from the Orders page.
faq.farmerSignup: How do I register as a seller?
faq.farmerSignupAnswer: Choose Sell produce on the role selection page, create an account, and wait for administrator approval.
faq.forgotPassword: I forgot my password. What should I do?
faq.forgotPasswordAnswer: Choose Forgot password on the login page and follow the instructions sent by email.
